queries.title: Column quality
queries.method: Full-row profile of up to 12 prioritized columns. Time and grouping fields are checked first; source record counts are not counts of unique people or events.
queries.sql:
SELECT 'year' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("year") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "year") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("year") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("year") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'city' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("city") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "city") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("city") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("city") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'phase' AS column_name, 'TEXT' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("phase") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "phase") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("phase") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("phase") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'amount' AS column_name, 'INTEGER' AS logical_type, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT("amount") AS missing_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "amount") AS distinct_values, CAST(MIN("amount") AS VARCHAR) AS minimum, CAST(MAX("amount") AS VARCHAR) AS maximum FROM "analysis_fixture"

queries.title: Scope and missing data
queries.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
queries.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "city" AS "source: city", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("city" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

queries.title: Differences by city
queries.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
queries.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "city" AS "source: city", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("city" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

queries.title: Largest changes over time
queries.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
queries.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "city" AS "source: city", "year" AS "source: year", "amount" AS "source: amount", "phase" AS "source: phase", CAST("city" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CASE WHEN REGEXP_FULL_MATCH(TRIM(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4}') THEN TRY_CAST("year" AS INTEGER) END AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_fixture"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN discovery_period - previous_period <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period
